messages.subject: About the pdf help documentation
parts: I want to find the help file of the new edition but failed. So where could I find it? Thank you

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] About the pdf help documentation
parts:
Hi,
camtrapR is currently not available on CRAN, so the PDF manual is also not available there. I'd recommend using the documentation in R with 
?functionName
until a new version is published.

The PDF manual will be available again when a new version is available on CRAN.
Best regards,
Jürgen
